cariboo.title: Massive gold mine casts shadow over municipal election in small Cariboo town
cariboo.description: Two candidates are campaigning for mayor, as approval of the Cariboo Gold Project has created disruption in the Gold-Rush-era town of Wells, B.C. — known for its vibrant artistic community and the gateway for Barkerville Historic Park and the Bowron Lakes.

all.title: Climate-driven wildfires in Canada could cost future generations trillions: study
all.description: "A motivation of this study was to put it into economic terms that the general public could grasp a little bit better," researcher Sian Kou-Giesbrecht said.
